title: Wings Food Industries v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Tarun Agarwala, J.; Vipin Sinha, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as infructuous on petitioner's statement.
headnote: Writ challenging additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, connected with similar pending petitions and given an interim restraint, was dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner's statement without a merits decision.
facts: M/s Wings Food Industries petitioned Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. in Writ-C No. 7964 of 2013. The writ was connected with WP No. 30582 of 2009 and similar matters challenging additional security demanded under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Respondents received three weeks to file a counter. Following the interim order already granted in the connected petition, the Court restrained demand of additional security until further orders. Petitioner's counsel later stated the writ had become infructuous.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging additional security demanded under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner's statement, without a merits decision on the clause.

not_decided.point: Validity of additional security demanded under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Petition dismissed as infructuous; the connected 4.20 challenge was not adjudicated.
